Darayana Kamala

Condominium in Kamala
HomeNew ProjectsDarayana Kamala

Project overview

Darayana is a new condominium project by The Title, the Phuket brand of Rhom Bho Property PLC, in Kamala on Phuket's west coast. The developer's project page, published on 27 October 2026, lists it as a new project in Kamala with the tagline "Where the stars embrace the sea".

The developer has not yet published the number of units, unit types and sizes, facilities, prices, ownership terms, payment plan or completion date, so none are shown here. Other The Title projects in Kamala, such as The Title Vivana and Coralina Kamala, are listed in our catalogue for comparison.

Message us on WhatsApp and we will send the current details and availability as soon as the developer releases them.
